direction.camera: Guide attention with riso texture; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: use two deliberate print-like color layers with clear hierarchy; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with spot color; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with flat layering.
direction.lighting: flat print illumination; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: porous stock and spot ink; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around graphic grain; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use riso texture,spot color,print misregister,editorial warmth,graphic grain,flat layering as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
